      "title": "Team permission check requires admin and owner instead of either",
      "body": "isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed as (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). This requires the caller to satisfy both checks, so a team admin who is not an owner, or an owner who is not considered an admin by the first query, is denied even though the intended check is admin OR owner. Use || and avoid running both queries when there is no team."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 168,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Emails are sent for the original guest list instead of the guests actually added",
      "body": "sendAddGuestsEmails is called with input.guests instead of uniqueGuests. Emails are therefore decided using addresses that may not have been added, such as existing attendees, duplicates, or blacklisted addresses. In particular, an existing attendee included in the request will be treated as a new guest and receive AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of the add-guests notification."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 74,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "security",
      "title": "Guest email filtering is case-sensitive and blacklist can be bypassed",
      "body": "blacklistedGuestEmails is lowercased but incoming guest emails are not normalized, and duplicate detection uses strict equality. A blacklisted address or an existing attendee email can bypass the block/duplicate detection by using different casing or surrounding whitespace. Normalize and trim guest emails before comparing."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 92,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "Read-then-create attendee update can create duplicates under concurrent requests",
      "body": "The handler reads existing attendees, filters guests, then creates attendees without a transaction, upsert, or guaranteed unique constraint. Two simultaneous addGuests calls with the same email can both pass the filter and create duplicate attendee rows, or cause unhandled database errors if a constraint exists."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/emails/email-manager.ts",
      "line": 525,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Add-guests emails ignore standard email disable settings",
      "body": "sendAddGuestsEmails sends organizer and attendee emails unconditionally. Unlike other email helpers, it does not accept eventTypeMetadata or check eventTypeDisableHostEmail/eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail, so event types configured to disable standard emails will still emit add-guests emails."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 158,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Calendar update uses caller credentials instead of booking owner credentials",
      "body": "EventManager is constructed with ctx.user and credentials from getUsersCredentials(ctx.user), even when the caller is only an attendee or team admin. The handler fetches booking.user.credentials but never uses them, so calendar updates may fail or target the caller's calendar rather than the booking owner's destination calendar."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Guests can be added to cancelled or past bookings via API",
      "body": "After loading the booking, the handler does not check booking.status or whether the event has ended before inserting attendees, updating calendars, and sending emails. An authenticated organizer/attendee can call addGuests for cancelled or past bookings, causing inappropriate notifications and calendar updates."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts",
      "line": 5,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "perf",
      "title": "No maximum limit on guests array",
      "body": "The guests field is an unbounded array of emails. An authenticated user could submit a very large list, causing bulk attendee creation, mass email sending, and calendar API load. Add a reasonable maximum array length."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 92,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "data",
      "title": "Seated event types are not handled when adding guests",
      "body": "For event types using seatsPerTimeSlot, the handler creates plain attendee rows without checking remaining seats or creating seat references. This can exceed seat capacity and leave seated bookings in an inconsistent state."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts",
      "line": 58,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Organizer lookup throws for bookings without a userId",
      "body": "The organizer lookup uses prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow with id: booking.userId || 0. If a booking can have a null userId, such as some team bookings, this queries user id 0 and throws, causing a 500 instead of handling the team/userPrimaryEmail case."
    },
    {
      "file": "apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx",
      "line": 43,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Error toast always prefixes undefined and never falls back",
      "body": "onError builds a message string from err.data?.code and err.message, then uses message || t('unable_to_add_guests'). When err.data?.code is absent, the message becomes 'undefined: ...' and is truthy, so the fallback is never shown. Build the message conditionally and provide a proper fallback."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx",
      "line": 46,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "doc_defect",
      "title": "Hardcoded English tooltip",
      "body": "The Tooltip content 'Remove email' is hardcoded instead of using the i18n t() function, so it will not be localized."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Team permission check requires admin and owner instead of either
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed as (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). This requires the caller to satisfy both checks, so a team admin who is not an owner, or an owner who is not considered an admin by the first query, is denied even though the intended check is admin OR owner. Use || and avoid running both queries when there is no team.

findings.title: Emails are sent for the original guest list instead of the guests actually added
findings.body: sendAddGuestsEmails is called with input.guests instead of uniqueGuests. Emails are therefore decided using addresses that may not have been added, such as existing attendees, duplicates, or blacklisted addresses. In particular, an existing attendee included in the request will be treated as a new guest and receive AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of the add-guests notification.

findings.title: Guest email filtering is case-sensitive and blacklist can be bypassed
findings.body: blacklistedGuestEmails is lowercased but incoming guest emails are not normalized, and duplicate detection uses strict equality. A blacklisted address or an existing attendee email can bypass the block/duplicate detection by using different casing or surrounding whitespace. Normalize and trim guest emails before comparing.

findings.title: Read-then-create attendee update can create duplicates under concurrent requests
findings.body: The handler reads existing attendees, filters guests, then creates attendees without a transaction, upsert, or guaranteed unique constraint. Two simultaneous addGuests calls with the same email can both pass the filter and create duplicate attendee rows, or cause unhandled database errors if a constraint exists.

findings.title: Add-guests emails ignore standard email disable settings

Unlike other email helpers, it does not accept eventTypeMetadata or check eventTypeDisableHostEmail/eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail, so event types configured to disable standard emails will still emit add-guests emails.

findings.body: EventManager is constructed with ctx.user and credentials from getUsersCredentials(ctx.user), even when the caller is only an attendee or team admin. The handler fetches booking.user.credentials but never uses them, so calendar updates may fail or target the caller's calendar rather than the booking owner's destination calendar.

findings.title: Organizer lookup throws for bookings without a userId
findings.body: The organizer lookup uses prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow with id: booking.userId || 0. If a booking can have a null userId, such as some team bookings, this queries user id 0 and throws, causing a 500 instead of handling the team/userPrimaryEmail case.

findings.title: Error toast always prefixes undefined and never falls back

When err.data?.code is absent, the message becomes 'undefined: ...' and is truthy, so the fallback is never shown. Build the message conditionally and provide a proper fallback.
